# `files_create_signed_url`

Sign (or re-sign) a shared object into a CloudFront download link, optionally IP-restricted; requires msg/files:write.

## Input schema

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "DateLessThan": {
      "description": "Absolute RFC 3339 expiry",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ExpiresIn": {
      "description": "ISO-8601 duration; exactly one of ExpiresIn/DateLessThan",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "IpAddress": {
      "description": "Optional CIDR; produces a custom policy restricted to it",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Key": {
      "description": "Object key, e.g. shared/\u003cuuid\u003e/video.mp4",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "Key"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```
